title: Singapore Development Centre opens
description: PayPal opens its Singapore Development Centre, its first engineering footprint on the ground in Singapore.
source: PayPal APAC Newsroom — 'Celebrating 15 years of the Singapore Development Centre' (SDC opened 2007; 15 years marked in 2022)

title: International headquarters and Asia expansion
description: Singapore becomes PayPal's international headquarters. PayPal doubles its Asia-Pacific team and adds more than a hundred roles in Singapore.
source: PayPal press release, 17 Mar 2010 — 'PayPal to Double Its Presence in Asia by End of 2010' (refers to Singapore as international HQ, 100+ new SG roles)

title: Innovation Lab opens, the first outside the US
description: PayPal launches its Innovation Lab in Singapore, its first anywhere outside the United States, working with universities, startups and small businesses.
source: Ministry of Trade & Industry SG — Speech at the launch of PayPal Innovation Lab; Digital News Asia / Finance Magnates (first PayPal Innovation Lab outside the US, 2016)

title: Deepening the Singapore fintech ecosystem
description: PayPal co-sponsors the Singapore FinTech Festival and backs local fintech talent, including a fintech scholarship worth 180,000 Singapore dollars.
source: PayPal Public Policy Newsroom — 'PayPal Co-sponsors 2017 FinTech Festival in Singapore'; scholarship coverage, Feb 2017

title: Singapore workforce expansion
description: PayPal grows its Singapore team by about 25 percent, roughly 150 roles, across software engineering, product, cybersecurity and data science.
source: Marketing-Interactive — 'PayPal to expand Singapore workforce by 25%, 150 jobs open' (2021)

title: Singapore Development Centre turns 15
description: The Singapore Development Centre marks 15 years powering global payments, engineering, information security and risk from Singapore.
source: PayPal APAC Newsroom — 'Here For the Long Run: Celebrating 15 years of the Singapore Development Centre' (2022)

title: Approaching two decades in Singapore
description: From a single delivery centre in 2007 to a regional hub, PayPal nears two decades in Singapore.
source: Derived from the 2007 SDC opening (PayPal APAC Newsroom). NOTE: 2026 = 19 years; the true 20-year anniversary is 2027 — adjust framing/date as needed.
